newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia Dec manufacturing input prices fall.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia Dec manufacturing input prices fall.

text.p: Australia's manufacturing input prices fell 0.2 percent in December from the previous month, and were 4.5 percent lower than a year before, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Monday.
Price falls for gold bullion and ores combined with continuing falls in grain and livestock prices were the main contributors to the fall in the index, the bureau said in a statement.
Manufacturing input prices fell in all but one month of the second half of 1996.
